labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Reports a broken link in the root docs and asks how to contribute the fix.

body:
Pull requests from outside the collaborator group are not open; the contribution rules ask you to describe the change in an issue first, and a maintainer decides whether it goes ahead. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) for the process.

For the broken link, please reply with the file and the link that fails, so a maintainer can check it. Related: #4029.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
